outcome: Produce clear, usable, distinctive product design with current direct visual proof.

motivations.constraint: Every product design choice needs current human eye, human brain, and human touch proof.
motivations.reason: Product design metrics and valid files cannot establish visual quality or product fit.
motivations.failure_prevented: Product design acceptance from unseen pixels or a numeric average.

motivations.constraint: Every repeatable product design mechanic uses one Mise task graph path.
motivations.reason: Product design judgment works better when deterministic checks expose current evidence and failures.
motivations.failure_prevented: Product design work that bypasses experiments, lower-owner locks, or package proof.

domain_failures: Product design passes structure checks but remains generic, confusing, inaccessible, or visually weak.
Product design claims quality from metadata, hashes, or unviewed captures instead of current human eye proof.
domain_evidence: Product design experiments, state records, rendered views, interaction paths, and same-executor vision receipts.
Human brain and human touch judgments with counterevidence, uncertainty, scope, and accepting owners.

research_receipts.claim: WCAG 2.2 sets access rules for product design.
research_receipts.limitations: It cannot judge product design fit or visual quality.

research_receipts.claim: Apple links product design size and space to ease of use.
research_receipts.limitations: It does not set each product design choice.

research_receipts.claim: Apple keeps product design focus apart from selection when an act changes context.
research_receipts.limitations: It does not set one product design style.

research_receipts.claim: GOV.UK gives product design space a clear role.
research_receipts.limitations: Its scale is not product design truth for all work.

research_receipts.claim: Agent Skills give product design work a portable file form.
research_receipts.limitations: The form does not supply product design judgment or sight.

disconfirmation.question: Can product design standards or metrics alone prove visual quality?
disconfirmation.result: No. Access rules cannot replace current product design sight.
disconfirmation.disposition: Keep product design measures and direct sight as two gates.
